seoTitle: Large Log File Viewer: Read Multi-GB Logs in Pages
metaDescription: Open a very large text log and page through it, jump to a percentage or search forward. Only the part you view is read. Free.
intro: A paged viewer that reads a big file in slices instead of loading it all.
why:
Editors struggle with logs over a gigabyte. This viewer reads the file with the browser File API in 512 KiB slices, so memory stays small.

It shows byte positions instead of line numbers because counting lines would need a full pass. Search goes forward from the current page. Paging and search were tested on an 11 MB file against Python.
howTo: Use the page buttons or jump to a percentage.
Enter text or /regex/ and press Find next.
Set lines per page up to 2000.

faq.a: No. The browser reads slices from disk locally.
